summary_en: This Phase II study tests azacitidine together with pembrolizumab in people with relapsed or refractory Hodgkin lymphoma. Both drugs are given into a vein: pembrolizumab over about 30 minutes every 3 weeks, and azacitidine over about 60 to 90 minutes on Days 1 to 7 of each 28-day cycle. The main outcome is not stated; the study aims to assess efficacy, safety, and tolerability.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase II prueba azacitidina junto con pembrolizumab en personas con linfoma de Hodgkin recidivante o refractario. Ambos medicamentos se administran por vena: pembrolizumab durante unos 30 minutos cada 3 semanas, y azacitidina durante unos 60 a 90 minutos los días 1 al 7 de cada ciclo de 28 días. El resultado principal no está indicado; el estudio busca evaluar la eficacia, la seguridad y la tolerabilidad.
who_for: Relapsed Hodgkin lymphoma involving extranodal sites
Hodgkin lymphoma patients not regarded as candidates for high-dose conventional chemotherapy
Age 1 year or older; ECOG performance status 3 or lower, or Lansky 50 or higher
AML with relapse or progression is also listed in the inclusion criteria; the record does not explain this
not_for: Allergy to azacitidine or pembrolizumab or their components
Known HIV infection, or active hepatitis B or C
Known active CNS metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
Active or prior autoimmune disease within the past 2 years, or immunosuppressive medication within 14 days before the first pembrolizumab dose
